A shallow dive into formal verification

Formal verification is the practice of mathematically proving that a program satisfies a specification. In the context of Ethereum, the highest-value target is the consensus client: a bug there is a chain split.

Why it is hard

Specifications themselves can be wrong, and the gap between the spec language and the implementation language is where bugs hide.

def verify(proof, statement):
    assert pairing_check(proof.a, proof.b)
    return hash(statement) == proof.commitment
  • Provers are slow
  • Specs drift

Still, the trend is positive & accelerating.
